name: vibecart
description: VibeCart — Shop Your Vibe | Modern full-stack personality & mood driven e-commerce application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run seed
